translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all twenty PDF page images. No prior English translation or translation service used. Edition glossary and primary dictionaries consulted; interpretation and uncertainties recorded per source ID. No independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p1547:b001:l001: Continues Kökchebich running at1546:40–42; after_id verified1546:42. No new horse introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p1547:b001:l013: Сары изине чөп салуу relentless pursuit,2015 phraseological dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/sary-izine-chop-saluu/. Not actually putting grass on tracks.
notes.manas-2010:p1547:b001:l019: Ninety Beijings retained as epic count without equating to modern cities.
notes.manas-2010:p1547:b001:l023: Handmade bronze Buddha image and its worship retained in narrator’s religious framing; not independently verified ritual description.
notes.manas-2010:p1547:b001:l029: Жаңырыктын Жар-Кыя rendered descriptive echoing cliff-path. Name versus formula remains uncertain; similar lower-case phrase appears in Semetey1959/Seytek1960. No mapped Zhar-Kyya locality asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1547:b001:l033: Ит уруш dog-like running fight: alternating rear-guard combat explicitly explained1553:23–28; not actual dogs in battle.
notes.manas-2010:p1547:b001:l039: Уй куймулчак cowlike lean haunches, exact racehorse usage in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/куймулчак/. Repeated1554:24,1564:26,1565:30.
notes.manas-2010:p1547:b001:l041: Чыпка matted/clumped,1969 and2015 dictionaries quote exact чыпка куйрук Сарала https://el-sozduk.kg/чыпка/. Not slender tail or filter.
notes.manas-2010:p1548:b001:l013: Closer musket targets retained despite lance at longer distance6–7; no tactical distance silently repaired.
notes.manas-2010:p1548:b001:l020: Visible алтынды gold retained in isolated wealth praise; not silently emended алптын giants to harmonize fighting context.
notes.manas-2010:p1548:b001:l022: Mother shot down with causative construction; agent compressed. Does not assert Almambet killed his mother. Father’s killing explicit26.
notes.manas-2010:p1548:b001:l024: Алтын тагын май кылган bloodied golden throne, exact Yudakhin phrase https://el-sozduk.kg/май/. Not greased throne.
notes.manas-2010:p1548:b001:l027: Бут idols in repudiation context, not anatomical feet.
notes.manas-2010:p1548:b001:l040: Turning horses’ rumps marks alternating retreat and rear-guard attacks41–42; no bodily mutilation.
notes.manas-2010:p1549:b001:l006: Коломочто- bare arms and prepare to fight, Yudakhin and2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/коломоч/. Compressed construction attaches lance as wielded weapon; not merely level lance.
notes.manas-2010:p1549:b001:l019: Fugitive-wretch insult is Kün Zhang-Zhung’s speech about Almambet.
notes.manas-2010:p1549:b001:l023: Taking back girls sent to Talas and adding1000 are enemy threats, not completed capture.
notes.manas-2010:p1549:b001:l026: Таш сайынган cap rank-buttons; таза finest at27. Established shared lexical correction, not jewels embedded in skin.
notes.manas-2010:p1549:b001:l028: Кызыл чок cap tassels; no burning heads.
notes.manas-2010:p1549:b001:l036: Axe-handle comparison describes bristling moustache, not an extra weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p1550:b001:l004: Among/encircled split at4/7 keeps the hero inside the enemy multitude without making him a Chinese hero.
notes.manas-2010:p1550:b001:l026: No sound patch left on body and blood27 are narrator’s injury hyperbole, not a medical assessment.
notes.manas-2010:p1550:b001:l031: Nominal Kongurbay line retained as abrupt transition before Chubak/Syrgak arrive. No missing predicate invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1550:b001:l042: Falling is possible capture, specified1551:1; not already dead.
notes.manas-2010:p1551:b001:l008: Horse-mouth opening rendered loosening reins, customary riding idiom.
notes.manas-2010:p1551:b001:l027: Object of grant unexpressed; no new victory or miraculous event supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1551:b001:l038: Кажыр griffon vulture, Yudakhin кажырII https://el-sozduk.kg/кажыр/. Generic black vultures retained for кара жору; no exact modern species survey asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1552:b001:l008: Көнүк seasoned/experienced warrior, established context-sensitive usage.
notes.manas-2010:p1552:b001:l017: Жөө күлүк here two-word fleet-footed Chinese description, not automatically Zhöökülük the previously killed named fighter.
notes.manas-2010:p1552:b001:l018: Toward champion Kün Zhang-Zhung is contextual attachment before Syrgak arrives19–21. Devoted comrade belongs with Syrgak’s own side, not an assertion of allegiance to Kün Zhang-Zhung; compressed syntax remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1552:b001:l025: Syrgak explicitly cuts the opponent’s head; Kün Zhang-Zhung’s death confirmed29. Arkesken22 is sword name.
notes.manas-2010:p1552:b001:l036: Image reads жалынып pleading where extraction has жалынын. Raw unchanged; visual correction only.
notes.manas-2010:p1552:b001:l041: Absence of support and Manas42 does not establish his death; enemy makes that claim1559:6.
notes.manas-2010:p1553:b001:l001: Speech provisionally Almambet, whose flight from Beijing is explicit first-person9–10. English quotation added for continuity, not source emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p1553:b001:l011: Кенел- gain abundance/enjoy, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кенел-/. Gaining no good is qualified literal negative in proposed retreat; context might suggest a defective form, but no кенебестен emendation or invented falling-prey meaning adopted.
notes.manas-2010:p1553:b001:l015: Survivors told to report suffering to Manas; future instruction not a completed return.
notes.manas-2010:p1553:b001:l023: Successive Chubak retreat, Almambet combat, Syrgak combat, Chubak return all retained23–28.
notes.manas-2010:p1553:b001:l035: Swarming-insect comparison preserves negative distinguishability clause; no actual metamorphosis.
notes.manas-2010:p1554:b001:l001: Swept up/driven along interprets overwhelming pursuit with three heroes as objects1553:41. Does not assert completed binding/capture.
notes.manas-2010:p1554:b001:l003: Seven days of Chubak alone retained despite preceding alternation. Nine days follows1555:15; chronology not silently harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1554:b001:l022: Ат оюнчу skilled riders in military context; not circus performers.
notes.manas-2010:p1554:b001:l027: Provisionally Chinese ignore slaughtered men as they attack28–34; subject compressed, not certain individual identification.
notes.manas-2010:p1554:b001:l031: Ок shots left generic after preceding arrows29; no unsupported firearm type.
notes.manas-2010:p1554:b001:l035: Shibee/Soloon explicitly two tribes; Tyrgoot/Kara-Kytay37 retained as ethnonyms without forced modern equivalence.
notes.manas-2010:p1554:b001:l040: Эрендерднн extraction spelling interpreted regular эрендердин; no semantic gap.
notes.manas-2010:p1555:b001:l002: Кыйла provisionally intensifies despair; not an invented number of lost lives.
notes.manas-2010:p1555:b001:l006: Аккаңкы white saddle as edition glossary1833, not a second horse-name; Алакең7 affectionate Alma.
notes.manas-2010:p1555:b001:l015: Nine days and ninety wounds18 retained literally as epic numerals.
notes.manas-2010:p1555:b001:l025: Gold mines and tea-gathering lands remain source descriptions; no modern mining or geographic identification.
notes.manas-2010:p1555:b001:l029: Ridge where enemies pour out and Syrgak waiting attached across25–32; no newly named pass supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1555:b001:l033: Dark-spirit affliction of wife is Kongurbay-riding simile, repeated1566:23. No actual wife’s illness narrated here.
notes.manas-2010:p1555:b001:l035: Spectacles and flask-sized head bead retained as source imagery; no dating of artifacts inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1556:b001:l008: All parenthetical8–12 verse translated. Black horse has literal flank wings and escapes mortal danger; not silently rationalized into speed.
notes.manas-2010:p1556:b001:l018: Parenthetical18–19 retained as verse. Бейжай extraordinary Chinese is provisional emphatic sense.
notes.manas-2010:p1556:b001:l023: Reeds and flood images retained with teeming soldiers, without replacing either with an omitted paraphrase.
notes.manas-2010:p1556:b001:l037: Algara is Kongurbay’s mount; conjunction with Ay Zhang-Zhung35 does not put both riders on one horse.
notes.manas-2010:p1556:b001:l040: Ravenless plain is epic landscape description, not a natural-history observation.
notes.manas-2010:p1557:b001:l003: Impenetrable army follows iron net2; not silently changed into armor.
notes.manas-2010:p1557:b001:l009: Rank-buttons/finest Chinese9–10 follow shared lexicon as1549:26–27.
notes.manas-2010:p1557:b001:l018: Эшип sweep away in attack context; exact physical motion remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1557:b001:l026: Age21 kept at source26, arrival at that age27. No cross-row age displacement.
notes.manas-2010:p1557:b001:l031: Kongurbay reports caravan-man’s news; nested speech carries over1558. No historical corroboration claimed.
notes.manas-2010:p1557:b001:l036: Filing past provisionally an assembly/muster; no additional inspection ritual invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1558:b001:l012: Manas’s spirit power excepted before Syrgak is called braver even than him13. Comparative андан retained, rather than unsupported rest; compare1565:9–10 exception of Manas’s fame.
notes.manas-2010:p1558:b001:l014: Nine great hosts retained for тогуз сан without multiplying into unsupported troop totals.
notes.manas-2010:p1558:b001:l022: Exact умачтай ачты уйкумду in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/умач/: thoroughly woke him; not literal flour soup.
notes.manas-2010:p1558:b001:l028: Боору бүтүн sound/unwounded, exact same dueling quotation in Yudakhin боор https://el-sozduk.kg/boor/. Broader carefree sense exists but exact passage supports bodily soundness.
notes.manas-2010:p1558:b001:l032: Syrgak’s lance-thrust still in bones means remembered/persisting pain; no literal retained shaft necessarily asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1558:b001:l040: Казыналык treasury/royal-household maidens. Precise institution unresolved. Proposal to confine Syrgak with40 women and obtain a male heir is retained as coercive enemy plan, not an event already enacted.
notes.manas-2010:p1559:b001:l006: Manas already dead is Kongurbay’s speech, not narrative confirmation. His absence elsewhere is not silently harmonized with this claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1559:b001:l016: Була valuables here, exact Yudakhin two-line quotation https://el-sozduk.kg/була/. Cloth/yurt furnishings senses underlie term; not fiber alone.
notes.manas-2010:p1559:b001:l019: Mecca exile, capture of wives/daughters and plunder retained as proposed punishments.
notes.manas-2010:p1559:b001:l027: Кээсин чыгаруу take vengeance, Yudakhin кээI https://el-sozduk.kg/кээ/. Provisionally revenge for people’s humiliation; exact possessive alignment in clipped clause remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1559:b001:l030: Not only other goods contextual elliptical emphasis leading to cattle31; no negation silently discarded.
notes.manas-2010:p1559:b001:l031: Үкүр cattle in Kalmyk epic speech, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/үкүр/. Not an unidentified proper name or an emended үкөк chest.
notes.manas-2010:p1560:b001:l008: Iron rope/net capture implements retained, not ordinary metaphor only.
notes.manas-2010:p1560:b001:l023: Тушарына теңебөө hold beneath notice,2015 dictionary quotes these same three lines https://el-sozduk.kg/ТУША/. Not literal fetters or spur attack.
notes.manas-2010:p1560:b001:l041: Repeated Ay Zhang-Zhung lance-thrust retained after previous attacks; not deduplicated.
notes.manas-2010:p1561:b001:l008: Чарайна mirror breastplate, established glossary equipment term; no human heart mirror metaphor.
notes.manas-2010:p1561:b001:l014: Бейбак affectionate sympathetic epithet for Kanykey, not a separate widowhood assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p1561:b001:l020: Айлан- devotion/honor sense, Yudakhin sense3 and1969sense8 https://el-sozduk.kg/айлан/. Contextual praise rather than metamorphosis into a steed; exact construction qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1561:b001:l031: Даңкан material kicked up by horse’s hooves, edition glossary1836:31–33. Bowl-sized stones not gemstones.
notes.manas-2010:p1561:b001:l036: Эрдин кесе тиште bite lip till blood, exact Yudakhin formula https://el-sozduk.kg/kes-/. Teeth crumbling38 remains separate extraordinary rage image, not silently softened.
notes.manas-2010:p1562:b001:l004: Only son’s death is simile for Kongurbay’s distress, not a newly reported bereavement.
notes.manas-2010:p1562:b001:l008: Sink into earth is character’s curse fully translated, not an unresolved utterance.
notes.manas-2010:p1562:b001:l022: Companions left by Manas retains speaker’s death claim from1559:6 without confirming it as narrator.
notes.manas-2010:p1562:b001:l042: Kongurbay slaughters his own fleeing soldiers, clear35–42; not replaced by an enemy target.
notes.manas-2010:p1563:b001:l020: Аты уйкаш paired names Almambet/Chubak, figurative association; not a literal English rhyme claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1563:b001:l024: Singular first-person жетем retained as each hero’s thought, despite plural heroes surrounding it.
notes.manas-2010:p1563:b001:l037: Not noticing Chinese expresses concentration on finding Syrgak, not their literal disappearance.
notes.manas-2010:p1564:b001:l013: Dead as bread beneath four hooves is trampling image retained without asserting horses eat corpses.
notes.manas-2010:p1564:b001:l028: Байлап held in check provisionally refers to Sarala26 and measured riding27. Exact object not independently settled; no stationary dismount/tether event invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1564:b001:l031: Exact күндүн куюн бузултуп жайлап жүрөт Алмамбет quoted in Yudakhin куйII https://el-sozduk.kg/куй/: turning weather foul by magic. Куюн is inflected куй here, not whirlwind.
notes.manas-2010:p1564:b001:l037: Black felt hat’s brim affectionate epithet for Syrgak40, not Karakalpak ethnicity.
notes.manas-2010:p1565:b001:l004: Samarkand’s gold bowls and cheap cloth parallel hero’s excellence; no price or geography claim added.
notes.manas-2010:p1565:b001:l011: Banner and gift refer affectionately to Syrgak brought to the expedition, not two newly introduced physical gifts.
notes.manas-2010:p1565:b001:l031: Sarala motion belongs to Almambet, supplied as subject36 for intelligibility; horse does not fire weapons32–35.
notes.manas-2010:p1565:b001:l035: Soloon ethnonym retained; wordplay with felling not an additional name.
notes.manas-2010:p1566:b001:l002: Кабагым-кашым дебөө without worry,2015 phraseological dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/kabagym-kashym-deboo/. Not merely risking eyebrows/face.
notes.manas-2010:p1566:b001:l010: Dazed and displaced warrior10–18 provisionally Almambet after his charge; subject unmarked and opponent also fell7–8. Rescue by Chubak39–40 favors Almambet, without an invented death.
notes.manas-2010:p1566:b001:l023: Wife afflicted by dark spirit is riding simile as1555:33, not an actual domestic episode.
notes.manas-2010:p1566:b001:l035: Oygut retained as epic ethnonym; no unsupported modern identity.
notes.manas-2010:p1566:b001:l039: Chubak’s willingness to sacrifice himself for Almambet attached across39–41; not completed sacrifice.
notes.manas-2010:p1566:b001:l042: Kögala is Chubak’s horse; clause continues1567. No ending invented at batch boundary.
